title: 芝加哥大学政治学教授Robert Pape：美军撤军是中东局势走向的关键指标
speaker: Robert Pape

segments.en: Oh, absolutely. I mean, if it turns out that President Trump doesn't just end the blockade, but withdraws 50, 70% of the naval assets that have been moved to the region, that's a huge indicator.
segments.zh: 哦，绝对是的。我的意思是，如果特朗普总统不仅解除封锁，还撤出部署到该地区50%到70%的海军资产，那将是一个巨大的指标。

segments.en: If we withdraw, say, 20,000 or 10,000 troops that we have put in since the war, that would really be a big indicator. So, for example, if those airborne troops were to be taken out of theater, that would be an indicator.
segments.zh: 如果我们撤出战后部署的2万或1万军队，那将是一个很大的指标。例如，如果那些空降部队被撤出战区，那将是一个指标。

segments.en: If the Marines would be physically lifted back to their bases in Asia and also in California, that would be a major indicator, but so far President Trump has said he's going to do that.
segments.zh: 如果海军陆战队被实际运回他们在亚洲和加利福尼亚的基地，那将是一个主要指标，但到目前为止，特朗普总统已经表示他会这样做。

segments.en: So in terms of this theory, the escalation trap, where do you think things are and where things stand now? We're in what I would call the middle game.
segments.zh: 那么根据这个理论，升级陷阱，你认为现在情况如何？我们正处于我所说的中局阶段。
